title: One Rule, One Curve: The Parabola Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
A cricket ball hit high falls back along one smooth curve, and a dish antenna on a roof has the very same curve. Why? In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 10, Conic Sections) we build the parabola from one simple rule: every point is as far from a fixed point, the focus, as from a fixed line, the directrix.

You will watch a live test move a point so that its two distances stay equal while the dots trace the curve, then derive y² = 4ax step by step. We grow a live so the parabola opens wider, find the latus rectum and its length 4a, and compare y² = 4ax with x² = 4ay to see which way each one opens. A pause-and-think question, a worked example with y² = 12x, the exam trap where 4a is mistaken for a, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
